description: Triggers headless code generation in S32 Configuration Tools for a single specific tool (Pins, Clocks, Peripherals, DCD, IVT, eFUSE, GTM, QuadSPI, or FFC) of an existing .mex project and exports the regenerated files to a target folder. Use when the user says "regenerate the pin mux", "refresh the clocks code", "export the peripherals HTML report", or wants to apply .mex edits to disk in a scoped way.
